cloud-far.notes: Native and4x: irregular fluffy white/sky-blue cloud bank, no dark contour or bead spheres; right canvas contact suitable for a continuous/offscreen far bank, not centered isolated sprite.

cloud-near.notes: Native/4x fluffy broken white-cyan cloud-bank clusters, no spherical balls or dark outlines, full alpha margins. A narrow gap separates cloud clusters; use as a bank rather than a single isolated puff.

horizon-mist.notes: Two broken horizontal pale cyan-white wisps with empty gaps, no outlined zigzag/ribbon or solid backdrop. Native and4x reviewed; low-opacity horizon use.

ledge-grass.notes: No stone background now, but silhouette became a circular vine/wreath rather than short grass; not accepted as grass. Ledge role will use a small copy of the already-passed PixelLab ribbon plant.

bubble-cluster.notes: Six clean cyan hollow rings with alpha-empty interiors and small highlights, no checkerboard or grey fills; native64x64/4x verified. Count differs from draft5 but fine for variable decoration.

water-specks.notes: Sparse separate1-3pixel pale aqua/cream motes on genuine transparent alpha, no rectangle/checkerboard; native64x64 and4x checked.
